title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - BanHub
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/BanHub. Hub of the BAN, mainly playing the role of both a data concentrator and a network gateway (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthDevice. The source ttl declares no rdfs:domain property for BanHub itself -- it is a pure specialization. It therefore inherits every property of HealthDevice (serialNb, isAttachedTo, hasInterface, locationRelativeToBody, availableFlash, availableRam, remainingBatteryLevel, computingPower, powerSource, rechargeable, numberOfPowerSource, availablePowerLevel, dimensions, weight, sendingFrequency, precision, hasFunction -- see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthDevice/schema.json) with nothing of its own declared in the source ontology. BanHub is the range of Ban.hasHub.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'BanHub'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
